units.source_text: 信辅的家里可以说很是贫穷。

en.t: Shinsuke's family could be said to have been quite poor.

units.source_text: 但是，他们的贫穷不是杂居在大杂院里的下层阶级的贫穷，而是为了外表体面而不得不忍受更多的痛苦的中下层阶级的贫穷。

en.t: But their poverty was not the poverty of the lower classes crowded together in tenement compounds; it was the poverty of the lower middle class, forced to endure even more pain for the sake of outward respectability.

units.source_text: 他的父亲从前是官吏，如今已经退休，

en.t: His father had once been a government official and was now retired,

units.source_text: 不包括那一点存款利息在内，

en.t: not counting the small amount of interest from their savings,

units.source_text: 他们一家四口加上女佣，五个人，

en.t: the four members of the family plus the maid, five people in all,

units.source_text: 就指望一年五百圆的养老金维持生计。

en.t: had to depend on an annual pension of five hundred yen to make a living.

units.source_text: 所以，必须节俭又节俭。

en.t: So they had to practice thrift upon thrift.

units.source_text: 他们住在一栋有小庭院的屋子里，

en.t: They lived in a house with a small garden,

units.source_text: 包括玄关在内总共只有五个房间。

en.t: and even including the entryway, it had only five rooms in all.

units.source_text: 家里人几乎很难穿上一件新衣服。

en.t: The family members could hardly ever put on a new piece of clothing.

units.source_text: 父亲每晚总是以喝一杯粗酒——一种拿不到台面上的酒——当做消遣。

en.t: Every night his father took his amusement in drinking a cup of cheap liquor, the kind one could not serve openly.

units.source_text: 母亲也以外面披上和服外褂来掩藏里面布满补丁的腰带。

en.t: His mother, too, would put a haori over her kimono to hide the patched sash underneath.

units.source_text: 而信辅，他直到如今都记得那张带着油漆臭味的书桌。

en.t: As for Shinsuke, even now he remembered that desk with its smell of paint.

units.source_text: 书桌是中古货，

en.t: The desk was secondhand,

units.source_text: 桌面上贴着绿色的绒布，

en.t: with green velvet pasted over its top,

units.source_text: 抽屉的拉把手闪着银色的金属光泽，

en.t: and the drawer pulls shone with a silvery metallic gleam,

units.source_text: 猛一看你还挺漂亮的。

en.t: so at first glance it looked rather handsome.

units.source_text: 实际上，绒布很薄，

en.t: In fact, the velvet was very thin,

units.source_text: 抽屉也很难拉开。

en.t: and the drawers were also hard to pull open.

units.source_text: 与其说这是他的书桌，毋宁说这是他家的象征。

en.t: Rather than calling it his desk, it would be better to call it a symbol of his household.

units.source_text: 象征着他家那种为了顾及体面而过的更加痛苦的生活……

en.t: It symbolized the more painful life his family lived in order to maintain appearances...
